title: Skill Manifest
description: Per-skill metadata. Each fixed skill in the harness has one manifest. Read by the orchestrator before dispatching the skill; enforces authority, mutation policy, redaction, and risk profile. Per Constitution Article 32 and F5 governance.

lifecycle.description: Product posture. Experimental skills require explicit activation and cannot promote supported readiness.

authority_role.description: Which role's authority this skill operates under. The orchestrator enforces path-based write restrictions accordingly.

deterministic.description: True if invocation with identical inputs produces identical outputs. Stochastic skills require retry-and-vote and confidence scoring.

llm_backed.description: True if the skill's run path invokes an LLM. llm_backed:true implies deterministic:false in practice (subject to retry-and-vote).

default_family.description: Phase-9 multi-provider routing hint. Skills declare a preferred model family; `auto` defers to .devai/config/llm.json's default_family. Operators override at the CLI.

agent_class.description: Phase-10 absorption of LAW-12.CLASS.* (D-38). coding-agent: reads + writes source, opens PRs. review-agent: reads + comments, NEVER writes source. ops-agent: triggers deploy / post-deploy / external mutations under per-action authorisation. The orchestrator MUST refuse actions outside the declared class.

permission_tier.description: Phase-10 absorption of LAW-12.PERM.* (D-38). read: read files + status queries. write: + modify files, create branches, run mutating local commands. act: + deploy, push to remote, mutate prod state — requires per-action authorisation. The runtime refuses to load a skill whose tier exceeds the session grant.

host_mutation_policy.description: read_only: no writes at all. evidence_only: writes only under .devai/evidence/. write_requires_flag: writes to host substrates allowed only with --write --write.

allowed_write_scopes.description: Path globs where this skill is permitted to write. The orchestrator blocks writes outside these scopes at tool layer (Article 6).

evidence_files.description: Files this skill produces as evidence artifacts.

redaction.description: Mandatory redaction policy applied to all evidence outputs.

fields.description: Field names to redact (token, password, secret, authorization, cookie, etc.).

patterns.description: Regex patterns matching secrets in unstructured output.

timeout_ms.description: Skill terminated and marked killed if exceeded.

risk_level.description: high/critical skills require additional confirmation; orchestrator may inject extra firewall checks.

entry.description: Canonical invocation entry point (CLI command, file path, function reference).

constitution_articles.description: Constitution articles this skill implements or enforces. For traceability.

family.description: Top-level taxonomy for orchestrator discovery (R3 / W2). Optional; absent = informal. Orchestrators predict skill names from family + gate_id / cycle_level + cycle_role.

gate_id.description: For family=fix skills: the gate this skill recovers. Matches sensor name or verb subnoun (e.g. 'lint', 'docs-links', 'action-coverage'). Convention: SKILL-fix-<gate_id>.

cycle_level.description: For family=cycle-driver skills: which work-break hierarchy level this skill drives. See docs/adopters/round-break.md.

cycle_role.description: For family=cycle-driver skills: which role at the cycle_level. Convention: SKILL-<cycle_level>-<cycle_role>.

auto_fix_capable.description: For family=fix skills: whether the skill can actually fix the gate it diagnoses. 'full' = autofix resolves typical failures (e.g., eslint --fix); 'partial' = autofix handles some failures (e.g., autofill missing fields); 'none' = diagnose-only, no autofix attempted. Orchestrators use this to skip iteration on diagnose-only skills (R4-W1; consumed by the iteration loop substrate in R4-W2). Optional; absent = unknown (orchestrators default to iterate once). family=fix skills SHOULD declare this; non-fix skills SHOULD omit it.
